    """Return a permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed (deterministic, no capabilities)."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 7) == []
    ex shuffled([1], 7) == [1]
    out = xs.copy()
    state = seed % 2147483648
    for i in range(out.len() - 1, 0, -1):
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
        j = (state // 16) % (i + 1)
        tmp = out[i]
        out[i] = out[j]
        out[j] = tmp
    return out
